documents.difficulty: One-page invoice: letterhead, boxed key/value panel, zebra grid line-item table with merged total rows, borderless bank table, typed dash list.

Two-page German datasheet: running header/footer, two-level table header with rowspan/colspan, hierarchical decimal list 2.1/2.1.1 with hanging markers, "(a)" and bullet lists, config block, boxed panel; soft hyphens in long words.
Two-page French meeting minutes: running header, "1)" / "a)" nested typed lists, headings H1-H3, rules-between-rows budget table, top-aligned multi-line action table, side-by-side signature boxes.

Flowing Spanish policy (2-3 pages): nested typed lists 1. / (a) / i., typed bullets and en-dash lists, rules-between-rows table, question-mark headings, margin-box running header and "Página X de N" footer.
Two-page Arabic RTL circular: letterhead, boxed key/value panel, Arabic-letter and Arabic-Indic numbered lists, RTL table with multi-line cell, CSS square bullets, Arabic-Indic page numbers.

Two-page Hebrew RTL service agreement: letterhead, numbered headings, Hebrew-letter list with nested "1)", decimal clause list 3.1-3.3 with hanging markers, RTL price table with merged total row, side-by-side signature boxes.
Two-page Japanese quotation: letterhead, key/value panel, grid item table with merged total rows, full-width markers （１）, circled ① and typed ・ bullets, kanji-numeral list 一、二、.
Two-page Simplified Chinese user manual: running header, headings with 一、, zebra spec table, decimal "1." and "（1）" lists, "（一）" list, boxed warning paragraph, full grid FAQ table.
Two-page Korean internal notice: key/value header panel, "1)" and "가." typed lists, table with rowspan groups, CSS square bullets, closing "끝." convention.
Two-page Russian job description: decimal "1.1." hanging list, two boxes side by side (rights | duties) with "а)" lists, grid KPI table, CSS square bullets, signature-sheet table.
Two-page Greek report: α) β) γ) lists with nested dash list, borderless table, subtotal row, section headings of three levels, running header and Greek page lines.
One-page Hindi scholarship notice: letterhead, key/value panel, (क)(ख)(ग) list, Devanagari-digit numbered list with nested (क), table with header and numeric cells.
One-page Thai announcement: letterhead, banner heading, schedule table, Thai-digit numbered list, CSS-drawn bullets, Thai page number; text written without spaces between words.
Two-page Persian RTL course syllabus: boxed key/value panel, Persian-digit and "الف)" lists, zebra weekly table, evaluation table with total row, bracketed reference list, Persian page numbers.

One-page Turkish annual-report summary: running header/footer, partly ruled indicator table (rules under header and between rows, no verticals), CSS round bullets, "1)" list with nested "a)", boxed key/value panel; dotted and dotless i.
One-page Georgian conference programme: banner, two side-by-side boxes (text+list | key/value panel), borderless time table, Georgian-letter list with nested "1)".

Flowing English command-line guide: headings to level 3, three code blocks (shell, YAML, JSON), zebra option table with multi-line cells, side-by-side text and exit-code table, CSS bullets, typed numbered list with dashes; margin-box running header and "– k –" page numbers.

Flowing two-column scientific paper: full-width title block, abstract, numbered headings, inline (i)(ii) list, booktabs table (rules at top, under header, at bottom), footnote, bracketed reference list with hanging indent; margin-box running header and "p. k".

Flowing three-page financial statement: 8-column table across pages (header row repeated by the renderer), section rows spanning all columns, subtotal and total rows, numbered notes with roman sub-items; narrow font; margin-box header and "Page k of N".

Two-page Portuguese menu: centred masthead, two boxes side by side (starters | mains) each with a borderless two-line-cell price table, boxed key/value panel, rules-between-rows table, typed "(1)" allergen list and dash list.

Flowing Italian tender specification: Art. headings, three-level typed list "1." / "1.1" / "a)" with hanging markers, long partly ruled table across pages with total row, typed "a)" duties list; margin-box header and "Pagina k di N".

Two-page community newsletter: masthead, headline article with a table BESIDE the text (sidebar), pull quote, CSS bullets, two-column page 2 (numbered "1)" list beside text), zebra fares table with centred cells, mixed alignment and colour.

Two-page laboratory report: letterhead, boxed 4-column key/value panel, results tables with two-line top-aligned cells and vertically centred status cells, table footnote, roman-numeral hanging list, side-by-side signature boxes.

Two-page Vietnamese tour itinerary: letterhead, schedule table with rowspan day cells, typed hyphen and bullet lists, price table with total-like surcharge row, "1)" list with nested "a)", heavy diacritics.
